newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank revises '96 C/A surplus to FIM 20 bln.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank revises '96 C/A surplus to FIM 20 bln.

text.p: The Bank of Finland on Tuesday revised the full-year 1996 current account surplus to 20.0 billion markka ($3.9 billion) from 19.2 billion projected earlier.

The revision followed the the National Customs Board's (NCB) official release of December and full-year 1996 foreign trade data, which showed a higher December trade surplus than the central bank had used in its calculations when releasing its current account data.
NCB said December's trade surplus was 1.86 billion markka compared with the central bank's estimate of 1.0 billion markka.
The full-year 1996 current account surplus at 20.0 billion markka was below the 1995 record surplus of 23.3 billion markka, the Bank of Finland said.
NCB said the full-year 1996 trade surplus fell to 44.8 billion markka from 47.5 billion in 1995. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
